name: elastic-tag-reorder
title: Elastic Tag Reorder
description: An interactive tag pill shelf where items exchange grid slots with smooth spring-driven layout shifts.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Tag Swap Shuffle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
